text_block_list.text:
The last day of summer camp is finally
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excelente! Camp sure was awesome,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Not only did I knock out my training, I
solved a
huge mystery!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Why do I want to become the world's
strongest
racer? What lies beyond that
dream?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It's aaall clear to me now!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
To entertain... That is what drives El
Condor Pasa.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the summer festival, the
clouds in her
mind have dissipated.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Which means this fall isn't just about the

champion's road and becoming the
world's
strongest racer...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's about getting the crowd hyped for a
battle
between rivals and friends—the
world's most
awesome show!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And in the center of the ring, the
spotlight will be
on me! I'll be a great
sun shining brighter and
stronger than
anyone else!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In which case, just running and winning
won't be
enough.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
There's gotta be a way to get everyone
even
more excited...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса is deep in thought trying
to find a
way to both aim for victory and
make the fall
races more enticing. I have
an idea.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: What if we hold an event?

text_block_list.text: Qué? An event?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's see... Event... Event...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I get it... I can get people excited
outside
of races too, can't I?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Trash-talking before the races, meet and
greets,
winning concerts...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: If we throw an event like that, then...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Bueno, Trainer! This is gonna be hella
fun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The summer fireworks have stopped. In
its place, I
can hear the new fall festival
music.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, let's go back to Академия Тайсен.
We've
got a fiesta to throw before the
Japan Cup!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
